_note: requests-inbound-to-queue D2 and D8. `inboundThreadKey` is written by InboundTicketService only: `conversation:<channelConversation id>` for WhatsApp and SMS, `mail:<account id>:<threadRootId>` for mail, `meta:<conversation id>` for Facebook and Instagram. A top-level property keeps the follow-up lookup a plain equality filter; the sender, domain, mailbox and source link go in `channelMetadata`. `category` becomes facetable so a team opens the Queue on its own category. Fragments are deep-merged onto pipelinq_register.json in filename order, so this one only adds these two keys to `ticket`.

inboundThreadKey.title: Inbound thread
inboundThreadKey.description: The conversation or mail thread an inbound message came in on. Written by the intake; a follow-up on the same thread is added to this ticket while it is open.
